questions.question_en: A focused phased array inspection is limited in path length by ______.
questions.question_ko: 집속 PA 검사는 무엇에 의해 경로의 길이가 제한되는가?
options: The transducers near field
The frequency of the transducer
The size of the elements
The grain structure of the component inspected

questions.question_en: At what range is the width of a conventional ultrasonic beam smallest?
questions.question_ko: 기존 초음파 빔의 폭이 가장 작은 범위는?
options: It depends on the wedge interface shape.
At the end of the nearfield
It varies with frequency, crystal size and excitation voltage.
At 3 times the crystal diameter.

questions.question_en: For a 7MHz, 16 element probe focused at 25mm, what would be the effect on the ultrasonic beam of an increase in element pitch from 0.5mm to 0.7mm?
questions.question_ko: 7MHz 16 element 25mm 집속 프로브에서 소자 간격 증가(0.5mm→0.7mm)가 초음파 빔에 미치는 영향은?
options: The near field will decrease
The focal spot size will increase
The focal spot size will decrease
Grating lobes will be induced

questions.question_en: A 1D transducer has elements.
questions.question_ko: 1D 탐촉자가 가진 소자는?
options: Has only one crystal, typical of conventional UT
Has an array of elements in the shape of a capital D
Has multiple elements in one axis and one element in the perpendicular axis
All the elements are one dimension to eliminate grating lobes

questions.question_en: What is a Focal Law as applied to phased array inspection?
questions.question_ko: PA 검사에서 적용되는 Focal Law란?
options: A basic ultrasonic phenomenon such as Snell's Law
A rule of thumb used by experienced UT operators
A law that states which elements to excite, when they are excited, how long for and which receive echoes
A law that governs the physics of probe design

questions.question_en: What is the correct definition to describe a Phased Array transducer?
questions.question_ko: PA 탐촉자의 정확한 정의는?
options: An ultrasonic probe with natural focusing and scanning abilities
An ultrasonic probe that generates its own pulses
Numerous separate ultrasonic probes individually pulsed for electronic scanning, focused beams and angled inspections
An ultrasonic crystal diced into elements individually pulsed for electronic scanning

questions.question_en: Phased array probes mounted on angled wedges.
questions.question_ko: 사각 웻지에 장착된 PA 프로브는?
options: Use transverse wave propagation
Use longitudinal wave propagation
Use modified shear waves
A and B are correct

questions.question_en: The near limit for a PA inspection is.
questions.question_ko: PA 검사에서 근거리 제한은?
options: The Dead Zone of the elements
Approximately 10% of the near field
There is no practical near limit
The near limit can be adjusted by focussing the probe

questions.question_en: Electronic scanning is.
questions.question_ko: 전자 주사는?
options: Using a robot to automatically scan a component
Utilising a linear scan with defined aperture along an array without mechanical movement
The PA term equivalent to PRF in conventional UT
The process of digitising an analogue signal

questions.question_en: A phased array linear scan is.
questions.question_ko: 선형 주사 PA는?
options: A straight line scan
A scan using a fixed focal law but incrementing different groups of elements
A scan using whole array to produce electronic rastering scan
A scan inspecting with range of angles

questions.question_en: In PA terminology 'Pitch' refers to.
questions.question_ko: PA 용어에서 Pitch의 의미는?
options: The angle a wedge is machined to
The protective coating on the face of a transducer
The distance between adjacent elements centres
The distance between adjacent elements

questions.question_en: What is the type of phased array scan that uses a series of focal laws to sweep through a range of angles from a fixed aperture?
questions.question_ko: 고정 조리개에서 각도 범위를 스윕하기 위해 일련의 Focal Law를 사용하는 PA 주사 유형은?
options: Sectorial
Linear
Arc
Dynamic depth focusing

questions.question_en: A phased array UT of 24mm thick single V butt weld is performed using a sectorial scan angle range 40~70°. If Omniscan index offset at 40° is set to 25mm, what is the index offset?
questions.question_ko: 24mm 두께 Single V 용접부 PAUT 검사에서 40~70° Sectorial Scan 사용 시 40°에서 Index Offset 25mm일 때 Index Offset은?

questions.question_en: Phased array inspection effectively steers ultrasonic beams by.
questions.question_ko: PA 검사는 무엇에 의해 초음파 빔을 조정하는가?
options: Novel design of wedge shape and material
Pulsing adjacent elements to bend beams
Utilising constructive interference to sum and concentrate energy
Using piezo-electric effect to mechanically alter propagation

questions.question_en: Dynamic Depth Focusing is.
questions.question_ko: Dynamic Depth Focusing이란?
options: Ability of equipment to focus at varying depths
Multi processing of returned signals to focus at varying depths
Ability to move focal point by changing transducer shape
Equivalent to TCG in conventional UT

questions.question_en: In PA terminology 'Aperture' refers to.
questions.question_ko: PA 용어에서 Aperture 의미는?
options: Area available to site the probe
Number of elements addressed by a given focal law
Length of transducer in active axis
Electronic snapshot area

questions.question_en: What is the active aperture when 32 elements are activated in a single focal law? Element width 0.5mm, gap width 0.1mm.
questions.question_ko: 32개 소자가 하나의 Focal Law에서 활성화될 때 Active Aperture는?

questions.question_en: Which is the maximum PAUT data sample spacing according to ASME Sec.V Art.4 for thickness greater than 3in.(75mm)?
questions.question_ko: ASME Sec.V Art.4 기준 75mm 초과 두께에서 최대 PAUT 데이터 샘플 간격은?
options: 0.5mm
1mm
2mm
4mm

questions.question_en: Which of the following is not examination area of weld for PAUT in ASME Sec.VIII Div.2?
questions.question_ko: ASME Sec.VIII Div.2 PAUT 용접 검사 영역이 아닌 것은?
options: Weld volume plus 3in on each side for thickness over 200mm
Weld volume plus lesser of 1in or t for thickness 200mm or less
Reduced examination volume including HAZ plus 6mm base material
10 times examination frequency

questions.question_en: What kind of defect is unacceptable regardless of length in ASME B31.1 Code Case 179 and HIE-NDT-PAUT-P11?
questions.question_ko: ASME B31.1 Code Case 179에서 길이에 관계없이 불합격인 결함은?
options: Crack
Lack of fusion
Incomplete penetration
All of above

questions.question_en: When performing PAUT for weld according to Mandatory Appendix 5 of ASME Sec.V Art.4, which of the following is not a minimum requirement of examination coverage?
questions.question_ko: ASME Sec.V Art.4 Mandatory Appendix 5에 따른 PAUT 검사 범위 최소 요구조건이 아닌 것은?
options: Search unit shall be maintained at fixed distance from weld axis
Scanning speed shall prevent data dropout more than 2 data lines per inch
E-scan overlap between adjacent active apertures shall be minimum 50%
S-scan angular sweep incremental change shall be maximum 2 degrees or assure 50% beam overlap

questions.question_en: Encoder shall be calibrated per manufacturer's recommendations at following intervals.
questions.question_ko: 엔코더는 제조사 권장사항에 따라 얼마의 주기로 교정되어야 하는가?
options: Not to exceed three months or prior to first use thereafter
Not to exceed one year or prior to first use thereafter
Not to exceed one month or prior to first use thereafter
None of the above

questions.question_en: According to ASME Code Case 2235-10 when inspecting weld thicknesses in excess of 25.4mm it is recommended to use.
questions.question_ko: ASME Code Case 2235-10에 따라 25.4mm 초과 용접부 검사 시 권장되는 것은?
options: Additional sectorial scans can be used
Additional linear scans and sectorial scans
Additional conventional UT scans are required
No additional scans are required

questions.question_en: What is the recommended minimum digitization rate for PAUT in Mandatory Appendix V of ASME Sec.V Art.4?
questions.question_ko: ASME Sec.V Art.4 Mandatory Appendix V에서 PAUT 최소 디지털화 비율은?
options: 3 times the examination frequency
4 times the examination frequency
5 times the examination frequency
10 times the examination frequency

questions.question_en: When inspecting according to ASME B31.3 Code Case 181, on wall thickness 24mm, what is the maximum size of a surface notch used for qualification block?
questions.question_ko: ASME B31.3 Code Case 181 기준 벽두께 24mm 인정시험편 표면 노치 최대 크기는?
options: 0.087mm high x 6.4mm long
1.04mm high x 6.4mm long
2.09mm high x 6.4mm long
4.18mm high x 6.4mm long

questions.question_en: When inspecting according to ASME B31.3 Code Case 181, on wall thickness 24mm, what is the maximum size of a subsurface notch used for qualification block?
questions.question_ko: ASME B31.3 Code Case 181 기준 벽두께 24mm 인정시험편 표면하 노치 최대 크기는?
options: 0.143mm high x 6.4mm long
1.72mm high x 6.4mm long
3.43mm high x 6.4mm long
6.86mm high x 6.4mm long

questions.question_en: Encoder shall be calibrated and confirmed by moving a minimum distance of.
questions.question_ko: 엔코더 교정 확인 시 최소 이동 거리는?
options: 150mm
400mm
500mm
600mm

questions.question_en: Phased array UT instrument shall meet the requirement of amplitude control linearity.
questions.question_ko: PAUT 장비는 증폭 직선성 요구사항을 어디에 만족해야 하는가?
options: For each focal law
For each pulser-receiver circuit
For each separate element
All of above

questions.question_en: What reference is used for personnel qualification and certification in HIE-NDT-PAUT-P11 according to ASME Code?
questions.question_ko: ASME Code에 따른 HIE-NDT-PAUT-P11 인원 자격 및 인증 기준은?
options: EN 473
ISO 9712
SNT-TC-1A

questions.question_en: ASME Code Case 2235-10 and Sec.VIII Div.1&2 describes that a qualification block must be used to qualify the PAUT written procedure. The block shall contain.
questions.question_ko: PAUT 절차서 인증용 인정시험편은 최소 무엇을 포함해야 하는가?
options: 2 OD/ID surface flaws and 1 subsurface flaw when both sides accessible
2 OD surface flaws and 1 ID surface flaw
No qualification block needed
1 OD surface flaw, 1 ID surface flaw and 1 subsurface flaw

questions.question_en: Evaluate acceptance according to ASME Sec.I PW-52 Nonmandatory Appendix E.
questions.question_ko: ASME Sec.I PW-52 Nonmandatory Appendix E 적용 시 합격 여부를 판단하시오.
